row_level_probability_equivalence.pass_rule: Every row must satisfy maximum_absolute_error and, where defined, maximum_relative_error; no quantile, mean, metric or aggregate substitution is allowed.

justification: Exact equality is expected for repeated executions in the same frozen single-thread environment. The 1e-12 absolute bound accommodates decimal serialization and final floating-point representation without accepting behaviorally material drift; the additional 1e-10 relative bound protects small nonzero probabilities. Exact state, ordering, calibration identity and decisions are categorical invariants.
failure_rule: Tolerances may not be widened, transformed or re-estimated after results; a breach fails the applicable scope.
